messages:
Jesse: Quick thread 9 - Northshore is greenlit for a week-long POC but security ops sent back a risk review. They flagged DSAR timelines, retention of inference logs, and whether we can provide a sub-processor attestation. Buyer is asking POC to start Mon. Can we cover those in the next 48h?

Nina: I'll do the POC infra (us-east-1) and enable workspace isolation. Need the approved DPA + SCCs and the sub-processor inventory. Also confirm if we can shorten request metadata retention for the trial.

Omar: Risk notes: 1) Inference logs (request/response) are retained 30 days by default. We can shorten to 7 days for trials via config but backups may remain for up to 30 days; that's contractual. 2) DSAR path: verify, collect, respond within 30 days. We can include a 30-day SLA in the trial contract. 3) Sub-processors: we have a maintained list and a routine attestation letter for customers on request.

Casey (Compliance): For vendor risk they wanted an encrypted-at-rest proof. We use AES-256 for data at rest and TLS 1.2+ in transit. KMS keys for Dedicated and Private; hosted API keys are managed by us but can be customer-managed in Dedicated/Private. I'll attach a snippet for SIG/CAIQ.

Priya (Legal): I uploaded the DPA + SCCs + processing addendum to the internal drive (link internal). Our standard clause forbids using customer content to train models; we also commit to deletion APIs. For DSARs we follow statutory timelines, and we can commit contractually to 30 days for hosted.

Jesse: Can we give them a sample deletion request that the buyer's privacy person can run during the POC? They want to test DSAR + deletion flows end-to-end.

Omar: Provide this example (admin-only):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/data/delete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"project_id":"northshore-poc","delete_scope":"all_inference_logs"}'
```
Note: this will queue deletion; response will include job id.

Nina: I'll also enable vector-store-disabled by default for the trial. If they want to persist embeddings we can enable it after sign-off and show the deletion API.

Casey (Compliance): For the SIG/CAIQ answers, pre-fill highlights: annual pen tests, bi-weekly vuln scans, SOC2 Type II report available, RBAC roles, MFA enforced, periodic key rotation. We generally commit to 72-hour breach notification.

Priya (Legal): The buyer asked for any customization on the DPA9 we can negotiate: deletion SLA, sub-processor notification period, and logging retention. Anything else?

Jesse: Also pricing question: if they convert the POC to Dedicated, what's the minimal commit? Sales note: suggest 3-month reserved minimum for initial Dedicated capacity. Can someone confirm numbers to propose?

Nina: I'll draft an email with DPA + SCCs link, the deletion example, and a note that vector persistence is off in trial. Also mention the option for Dedicated with KMS and custom retention.

Omar: I'll take SIG/CAIQ prefill and sub-processor attestation. Priya can review legal bits. We should be good to hit Monday start if legal provides the DPA link by tomorrow.

Priya (Legal): Uploaded DPA v3 and sub-processor attestation doc to drive: https://redwood.internal/dpa-v3. Sent to Jesse for outbound.

InfraBot: Provisioned trial workspace northshore-poc-324 (us-east-1) with lease rwd-9092. Assigned: Jesse, Nina.

Jesse: Great, thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the buyer comms.

Nina: FYI buyer also asked for a short clause about data export on termination  they want 90 days to export logs and vectors. We can offer 90-day export window in contract for Hosted.

Priya (Legal): We can include a 90-day export window for Hosted in the DPA addendum. I'll add a clause and share a redline.
